topics.topic: Partial Fractions: Distinct linear, repeated linear, and irreducible quadratic factors
learningObjectives: Decompose proper rational algebraic fractions with distinct linear factors in denominators
Resolve fractions containing repeated linear factors like (ax + b)²
Handle denominators containing irreducible quadratic factors like (ax² + bx + c)

topics.topic: Integration Techniques: Integration by substitution and algebraic partial fractions
learningObjectives: Execute algebraic integration using appropriate variable substitution (u-substitution)
Integrate rational algebraic expressions resolved into partial fractions
Evaluate definite integrals using substitution with adjusted boundary limits

topics.topic: Integration by Parts: Formula ∫ u dv = uv - ∫ v du and repeated parts
learningObjectives: Derive integration by parts from the differential product rule
Select appropriate choices for u and dv using the LIATE prioritization rule
Apply repeated integration by parts to cyclic functions like e^x sin x

topics.topic: Differential Equations: First-order ordinary differential equations with separable variables
learningObjectives: Define order and degree of ordinary differential equations (ODEs)
Solve first-order ODEs by direct separation of variables: f(y) dy = g(x) dx
Determine particular solutions satisfying given initial or boundary conditions

topics.topic: Mechanics: Statics of coplanar forces, resolution, and moments of forces
learningObjectives: Resolve systems of coplanar forces along orthogonal Cartesian axes
Apply Lami’s Theorem to systems of three coplanar forces in static equilibrium
Calculate moments of forces and apply the Principle of Moments to uniform and non-uniform beams

topics.topic: Mechanics: Friction and motion on rough horizontal and inclined planes
learningObjectives: State laws of solid dry friction and define coefficient of friction (μ = tan λ)
Analyze forces acting on bodies in limiting equilibrium on rough inclined planes
Calculate minimum tractive forces required to prevent sliding or produce motion up inclined planes

topics.topic: Mid-Term Continuous Assessment & Mock WASSCE Mechanics Clinic
learningObjectives: Assess pupil mastery of advanced integration techniques and statics equilibrium
Administer timed test matching WASSCE Further Mathematics Paper 2 section structure
Remediate common algebraic errors in partial fraction decomposition

topics.topic: Mechanics: Projectiles launched at an angle to the horizontal
learningObjectives: Derive parametric and Cartesian trajectory equations for projectiles under gravity
Calculate time of flight (T = 2u sin θ / g) and maximum height (H = u² sin² θ / 2g)
Determine horizontal range (R = u² sin 2θ / g) and velocity vector at any elapsed time t

topics.topic: Statistics: Correlation coefficient (Pearson and Spearman Rank) and linear regression
learningObjectives: Calculate Pearson’s product-moment correlation coefficient r from bivariate data
Compute Spearman’s rank correlation coefficient for qualitative ordered rankings
Determine lines of regression of y on x using the method of least squares

topics.topic: Normal Distribution: Standard normal variable Z, normal tables, and hypothesis testing basics
learningObjectives: Understand properties of the Gaussian bell-shaped continuous normal curve
Transform raw scores X to standard normal scores using Z = (X - μ) / σ
Use cumulative normal probability distribution tables to calculate probabilities and percentiles

topics.topic: Operations Research: Linear Programming (graphical maximization and minimization)
learningObjectives: Formulate linear objective functions and linear inequality constraints from word problems
Graph constraint boundaries and shade the common feasible solution polygon
Locate optimal solutions using vertex evaluation and objective line sliding methods

topics.topic: Comprehensive WASSCE/NECO Further Mathematics Revision & Speed Marathon
learningObjectives: Review entire 3-year Further Mathematics curriculum across Pure Maths, Mechanics, and Statistics
Solve past 5 years of WASSCE/NECO Paper 1 (objective) and Paper 2 (theory) questions
Coach students on examination time allocation, accuracy checks, and step-by-step presentation

topics.topic: Terminal Mock Examination and Broadsheet Certification
learningObjectives: Conduct full mock WASSCE Further Mathematics examination across Papers 1 and 2
Grade scripts according to official WAEC marking schemes and penalize rounding errors
Certify broadsheet entries and generate graduation readiness assessments
